messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: streaming decode p99 spike detected in us-west-2 (model-v2). p95->450ms, p99->2.3s, increased stalls in streaming pipeline. Auto-page to #eng-oncall.

olivia: I'm on it. seeing alerts + SLO dashboard shows breaches on 2 clusters. any recent rollout? :eyes:

ajay: pushed a kernel roll (trt8/flashattn) 12m ago to canary then grad to us-west-2 pool at +8m. compiler flags: -O3 -fstrict-aliasing -ffast-math rolled for decode path.

maria: infra telemetry -> kernel build id bld-20260312-trt8 deployed. node-level logs show increased pagefaults and KV eviction spikes during long-halo contexts.

derek: p99 tail looks correlated with KV cache misses + host-level swap churn. streaming stalls show "evicting KV pages" in runtime logs.

olivia: timeline makes sense. immediate mitigation options: rollback kernel to previous build, disable new compiler flags, or route streaming traffic to dedicated pool that still runs older kernel. preference?

ajay: fastest is to roll back the kernel at cluster level (k8s DaemonSet rollback). alternative: temporarily pin model routing to dedicated nodes (tier-dedicated-usw2) — requires routing config change in control plane (few minutes).

maria: I can flip routing if ops approves. rollback needs a build rollback + node restart; +/- 6m for drain per node.

olivia: let's do routing first to reduce customer impact while we coordinate rollback. sam, any known customer impact?

sam: product telemetry flags AlphaCorp and BetaApps with elevated stream stalls; AlphaCorp reports customers seeing progress stalls at ~10-15% of streams. raising priority for SRE.

olivia: OK. maria -> route all model-v2 streaming requests in us-west-2 to tier-dedicated-usw2, weight=100 for next 10m. after traffic shift monitor p95/p99 and request counts.

maria: doing that now. patching routing policy:

```
# control-plane patch
PATCH /v1/routing/policies/model-v2
{
  "region":"us-west-2",
  "fallback":"tier-dedicated-usw2",
  "weight":100,
  "reason":"emergency paging - revert kernel-induced stalls"
}
```

maria: routing change applied. samples: 2.1k rps shifted -> dedicated pool.

infra-bot: routing-change: success (id: rc-177990-01). 2.1k requests/sec moved.

olivia: monitoring now. ajay, start preparing rollback plan for kernel build bld-20260312-trt8 in case dedicated pool also triggers issues. include rollback image tag and a safe window for node drains.

ajay: rollback plan:
- tag old kernel image: redwood/kernel:bld-20260305-trt7
- update DaemonSet image & trigger rolling restart with maxUnavailable=1
- monitor p95/p99, CPU/GPU utilization, pagefaults
- expected full rollout finish ~18m (region-sized)

ajay: command to start rollback (in case we go that route):
```
kubectl set image ds/redwood-kernel redwood-kernel=redwood/kernel:bld-20260305-trt7 -n runtime
kubectl rollout status ds/redwood-kernel -n runtime
```

olivia: good. initial metrics after routing shift: p95 dropped from 450ms -> 95ms within 60s, p99 down from 2.3s -> 210ms. stalls reduced by ~92%.

sam: AlphaCorp support: their test streams are green now, sending them a note.

olivia: great. we'll hold routing in fallback for 30m to ensure stability, then consider gradual resume to primary kernel while we run longer tail tests.

derek: long-tail tests: run evictions/press tests with ~3x seq-len distribution for 30m on canary with instrumentation on kv_hit_rate, pagefault_rate. I'll kick off load.

derek: load job started -> job id load-177990-1. watching KV metrics.

ajay: also bisecting compiler flags locally. early smoke shows -ffast-math interacts poorly with new flashattn kernel causing suboptimal mem layout. suspect combination causes extra page thrash.

olivia: action items:
- maria: keep routing patched (fallback) for 30m, then we'll reassess.
- ajay: prepare rollback artifact and plan; attempt reproducer for flag combo.
- derek: run extended stress and report KV/pagefault metrics.
- sam: update AlphaCorp case and log mitigation note.

maria: noted. keeping route fixed. infra-bot will alert if dedicated pool saturates >75%.

olivia: handing off to next oncall for follow-up and potential rollback. jordan, take it from here if we see any regression after the 30m hold. summary: routing fallback applied -> immediate p99/p95 improvement; suspected kernel+compiler-flag regression (bld-20260312-trt8 + -ffast-math). rollback plan ready if needed. customer impact: AlphaCorp/BetaApps saw ~10-15% stream stalls, now mitigated.

jordan: got it — I'll watch dashboards and be ready to run rollback. please post rollback approval here if metrics degrade.

olivia: thanks team. closing active page for now but keeping this thread open for updates. please tag with "update" when you have reproducer or rollback started. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PAGING: incident status -> mitigated (traffic fallback in place). follow-up: postmortem required if rollback or code revert occurs.
